label: Terms from a formula
subgoals: An explicit formula gives a term directly from its index.
Substitute n into the formula to get the nth term.

label: Arithmetic and geometric cases
subgoals: An arithmetic sequence has a constant difference d.
A geometric sequence has a constant ratio r.
Both can be written as explicit formulas in n.

label: Comparing with recursion
subgoals: A recursive rule needs one or more starting terms.
An explicit rule jumps straight to any term.
The two descriptions can define the same sequence.
